title: VTG Johnny Mathis The Magic Of Johnny Mathis 8 Track Tape Columbia TC8 Stereo
descriptionText: The product is an 8-track tape featuring the album "The Magic Of Johnny Mathis" by artist Johnny Mathis, released by record label Columbia in stereo format. This vintage piece offers a nostalgic listening experience of Mathis' smooth vocals in the classic 8-track audio format, perfect for collectors or music enthusiasts looking to enjoy the magic of Mathis' music in its original form.
